about_the_game:
The World

The technology to recreate the memories of the deceased soon led to forbidden research aimed at materializing the soul itself. As a result, the "Soul Outburst Incident" swept across the entire world.

Countless humans vanished, and those who remained were mutated into monstrous creatures called Creatures. Humanity retreated into Haven—a safe zone where only the chosen few can survive.

You are a special investigator from the Soul Stabilization Union (SSU). To investigate the cause of recent anomalies occurring near Haven, you are dispatched into the outside world, now overrun with Creatures.

A shattered world. Hidden truths. The price of misguided choices.

Survive and reach the truth. To prove that this catastrophe was no accident.

Game Genre & Features

"Soul Trigger" is a strategic adventure RPG set in an urban fantasy world.

It offers a unique gameplay experience that combines character-driven narrative depth, modular exploration, and a half real-time turn-based combat system.

Strategic Half Real-Time Combat System

A distinctive combat system that delivers both the depth of turn-based strategy and the tension of real-time action.

  • Control one character at a time, switching between allies as the situation demands to take down enemies.

  • Exploit enemy weaknesses to inflict a [Down] state, neutralizing foes and gaining combat advantages.

Growth Systems for Stylish Combat

  • Develop characters to match their combat styles through [Basic Stat Enhancement] and the [Exclusive Card] system.

  • Combine skill effects and additional abilities via the [Implant] and [Resonance Engraving] systems to create different builds and strategies for every battle.

Modular Exploration System – Region Exploration in [Room] Units

Exploration consists of various Room types: Combat, Event, and Mid-point Outpost:

  • Combat Rooms: Engage in battles with monsters themed to each region and acquire resources for character development.

  • Event Rooms: Encounter random events based on the world's lore, with opportunities to meet NPCs, earn rewards, and gain buffs.

  • Mid-point Outpost Rooms: Recover HP and return to base safely. A checkpoint to decide whether to press on or retreat.

Each expedition generates a randomized map layout — even in the same region, every run demands different routes and strategies. Which room to enter, when to retreat — every decision impacts your survival and rewards.

Multi-layered Narrative and Character Growth

Experience the gradually expanding world and character development through the main story, side quests, and NPC missions.

  • Main Story: The core narrative of growth through choices and actions amid a world in crisis. New systems and content unlock as you progress.

  • Side Quests: Delve into hidden events and characters behind the main story, expanding the world's depth while providing rewards that add variety to gameplay.

  • NPC Missions: Interact with NPCs who each have their own purposes and stories, experiencing the world through the perspective of individuals struggling to survive.

Exploration Loop Centered on Your Base

  • Players select 3 characters from the main base to begin their expedition.

  • Gather resources through exploration, enhance characters at the base, then embark on new expeditions—a repeating structure that provides high immersion and replay value.

Stylish Visuals: 2D Characters × 3D Backgrounds

Expressive 2D illustrated characters combined with immersive 3D environments create a distinctive and refined visual style.
